question: The value of frac{left{(m²+n²)(m-n)-(m-n)³right}}{(m² n-m n²)} is:
solution:
**Given:**

Equation = frac{left{(m²+n²)(m-n)-(m-n)³right}}{(m² n-m n²)}

**Formula Used:**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

**Calculations:**

The equation is 

⇒ ((m²+n²)(m-n) -(m-n)³)/(m²n-mn²)

⇒ ((m-n)[(m²+n²) -(m-n)²])/((mn)(m-n))

⇒ ((m²+n²) -(m²+n²-2mn))/((mn))

⇒ (m²+n²- m²-n²+2mn)/(mn)

⇒ (2mn)/(mn)

⇒ 2

⇒ **Hence, The value of the equation is 2.**
